# Wayfinder contract smoke fixture

This fixture begins with a complete map-only Wayfinder effort. The policy source
is important across several planned implementation sessions, so one evidence
record and one supported `F1 — Python 3.11 is the minimum supported runtime`
section in the root `facts.md` ledger are useful. The reconciled map must link
directly to that section. Ordinary repository instructions do not need their
own evidence or fact records.

The three slices in `rollout-plan.md` are already approved. Their granularity
and blocking edges do not need another user review before local publication.
